name: Crystal Ball of Mind Reading

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Detect Thoughts
powers.text: While scrying, cast Detect Thoughts (save DC 17) on a creature you see through the sensor.

summary: Cast Scrying (save DC 17) through it. Plus more.
text: A glass sphere roughly 6 inches across. Touch it to cast Scrying (save DC 17) through it. During that scrying, you may also use Detect Thoughts (save DC 17) on any creature in view within 30 feet of the scrying sensor.
